## Methodology

- **Session discovery**: walks `sessions/session-*/` and `sessions/archive/session-*/` directories matching the `session-N[a-z]?` naming convention.
- **WP file detection**: matches `*workingpaper.md` files passing the `_WP_FILENAME_RE` filter from `extract_entities.py`.
- **Constraint-Map detection**: the `_WP_CMAP_SECTION_RE` regex matches `## Constraint[-\s]?Map[-\s]?(?:Update|Updates)?` with optional Roman-numeral prefix (e.g., `## V. Constraint Map Update` in S40).
- **Closure extraction**: rows are emitted when any cell contains a closure marker (`CLOSED`, `LANDED`, `PINNED`, `REGISTERED`, `PROMOTED`, `STAGE-3-PERMANENT`, etc.). Schema-tolerant: works across S43/S76/S86 column orderings.
